description: Confirmed syntax/range defects; normalization must retain their mismatches.

cases.key: A lambda_literal > ERROR simple_identifier | psi VALUE_PARAMETER
cases.grammarArea: lambda parameter/arrow ASI

cases.key: A navigation_suffix > ERROR quest | psi CALLABLE_REFERENCE_EXPRESSION
cases.grammarArea: generic nullable callable receiver and quest disambiguation

cases.key: A infix_expression > ERROR simple_identifier | psi STRING_TEMPLATE
cases.grammarArea: raw string delimiter/interpolation scanner

cases.key: C token span: PSI QUEST is not represented
cases.grammarArea: horizontal quest lookahead token start/end
quoted-string scanner resumes interpolation after escaped dollar
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has an escaped dollar and a LONG_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY; native has only literal string_content containing ${x}.
cases.key: C @ … > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE > LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY: psi literal content/source span / ts different literal content/source span

cases.grammarArea: soft data modifier versus indexed assignment and positional destructuring conflict
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has BINARY_EXPRESSION with ARRAY_ACCESS_EXPRESSION receiver data; native treats data as class_modifier and makes DESTRUCTURING_DECLARATION.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts DESTRUCTURING_DECLARATION

cases.grammarArea: raw-string closing quote run and content token end
cases.psiVsNative: PSI literal content is x followed by a quote; native string_content ends before that quote, leaving a missing REGULAR_STRING_PART span.
cases.key: C token span: PSI REGULAR_STRING_PART is not represented

cases.grammarArea: generic call dynamic precedence versus prefix unary expression
cases.psiVsNative: PSI is PREFIX_EXPRESSION(CALL_EXPRESSION); native is CALL_EXPRESSION(PREFIX_EXPRESSION), changing the operator receiver.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi PREFIX_EXPRESSION / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: for control-body ownership across newline before qualified call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI FOR owns the qualified call in BODY; native FOR has no control_structure_body and leaves the call as a sibling.
cases.key: C @ … > BLOCK > FOR > BODY: psi DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: hard literal/this/null keyword selectors versus identifier tokens
cases.psiVsNative: PSI preserves a BOOLEAN_CONSTANT selector; native uses a simple_identifier selector and loses the literal kind. Identifier spelling must not be guessed by normalization.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: annotation-prefixed assignment expression versus named value argument
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a BINARY_EXPRESSION with an annotated left operand; native consumes x as the named-argument name and leaves annotation plus call siblings.
cases.key: C @ … > CALL_EXPRESSION > VALUE_ARGUMENT_LIST > VALUE_ARGUMENT: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts ANNOTATION_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: generic call suffix versus binary operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI BINARY_EXPRESSION contains two calls; native attaches the right generic call suffix to the whole additive expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: generic call suffix versus elvis expression precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI elvis BINARY_EXPRESSION has a call RHS; native CALL_EXPRESSION applies its suffix to the entire elvis expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: expression annotation versus binary operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI annotates the left operand; native prefix_expression annotates the entire additive expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts ANNOTATED_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: expression annotation versus cast operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI casts an annotated call; native annotates the entire cast.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_WITH_TYPE / ts ANNOTATED_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: expression label versus binary operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI labels the left operand; native labels the entire additive expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts LABEL

cases.grammarArea: expression label versus cast operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI casts a labeled lambda; native labels the entire cast.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_WITH_TYPE / ts LABEL

cases.grammarArea: newline separates a try expression from a following lambda statement
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a try initializer and a sibling lambda; native makes the lambda a call suffix of try.
cases.key: C @ … > FUN > BLOCK > PROPERTY: psi TRY / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: newline separates an if expression from a following lambda statement
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has sibling IF and LAMBDA_EXPRESSION statements; native calls the IF with the lambda.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi IF / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: newline separates a literal expression from a following lambda statement
cases.psiVsNative: PSI keeps the integer and lambda as siblings; native calls the integer with a lambda suffix.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi INTEGER_CONSTANT / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: newline separates lambda initializer and lambda statement
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a lambda initializer and sibling lambda; native calls the initializer with the second lambda.
cases.key: C @ … > FUN > BLOCK > PROPERTY: psi FUNCTION_LITERAL / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: semicolon before else and unary expression branch ownership
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has an IF with unary minus ELSE; native terminates IF and parses else-y as a sibling additive expression.
cases.key: C @ … > FUN > BLOCK > IF: psi PREFIX_EXPRESSION / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: qualified user type versus navigation after a type check
cases.psiVsNative: PSI tests against qualified type A.B; native parses navigation of the check this is A.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi IS_EXPRESSION / ts DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: quoted string escaped dollar token extent
cases.psiVsNative: PSI preserves the escaped dollar entry; native string_literal has no content token for it.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE: psi LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: quoted string escaped dollar versus short interpolation scanner
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has two escaped dollars and literal d; native starts a short interpolation at the second escaped dollar.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE: psi LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY / ts INVALID_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE

cases.grammarArea: raw string backslash does not escape interpolation
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has literal backslash and long interpolation; native consumes all of them as string_content.
cases.key: C @ … > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE > LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY: psi literal content/source span / ts different literal content/source span

cases.grammarArea: short string interpolation with escaped identifier
cases.psiVsNative: PSI recognizes a short interpolation containing an escaped identifier; native emits literal string_content.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE: psi SHORT_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY / ts LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: multi-dollar short interpolation with escaped identifier
cases.psiVsNative: PSI recognizes the escaped identifier after the active multi-dollar prefix; native emits literal content.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > STRING_TEMPLATE: psi SHORT_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY / ts LITERAL_STRING_TEMPLATE_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: modifier and function declaration versus infix expression ambiguity
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a FUN with companion modifier; native parses an infix expression and lambda call.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: FUN @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: labeled context receiver declaration prefix
cases.psiVsNative: PSI places labeled B in the CLASS context list; native parses a context call followed by CLASS.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: CLASS @ ts simple_identifier / psi CONTEXT_PARAMETER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: context prefix of anonymous function declaration
cases.psiVsNative: PSI places the context list on FUN; native leaves a sibling call to context.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: FUN @ ts simple_identifier / psi CONTEXT_PARAMETER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: newline modifier ownership for anonymous function declarations
cases.psiVsNative: PSI starts FUN at inline; native leaves inline as a sibling identifier and starts FUN at fun.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: FUN @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: modifier and property accessor versus infix expression ambiguity
cases.psiVsNative: PSI nests a modified setter under the first property; native leaves an infix expression between properties.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: PROPERTY_ACCESSOR @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: contextual accessor keyword versus ordinary reference expression
cases.psiVsNative: PSI keeps set as a reference; native creates a setter declaration.
cases.key: C declaration start only in ts: PROPERTY_ACCESSOR @ ts function_declaration / psi REFERENCE_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: for control-body ownership across newline before literal
cases.psiVsNative: PSI FOR owns the string literal in BODY; native leaves FOR without a body and the string as a sibling.
cases.key: C @ … > BLOCK > FOR > BODY: psi STRING_TEMPLATE / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: script semicolon ends property before get call assignment
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has PROPERTY then call-assignment initializer; native associates get as the property's accessor.
cases.key: C declaration start only in ts: PROPERTY_ACCESSOR @ ts getter / psi REFERENCE_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: multiple type annotations before extension function type receiver
cases.psiVsNative: PSI puts both annotations on the whole function type; native attaches the second annotation to its receiver type.
cases.key: C @ … > USER_TYPE > TYPE_ARGUMENT_LIST > TYPE_PROJECTION: psi ANNOTATION_ENTRY / ts FUNCTION_TYPE

cases.grammarArea: getter-like branch call versus call suffix on IF
cases.psiVsNative: PSI IF owns a postfix call in THEN; native applies a call suffix and postfix operator to IF itself.
cases.key: C declaration start only in ts: PROPERTY_ACCESSOR @ ts getter / psi REFERENCE_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: nested labels on do while without brace body
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has labeled DO_WHILE; native parses an infix expression under the labels.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi DO_WHILE / ts BINARY_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: generic class reference in statement versus comparison expression
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a class literal with generic receiver; native parses nested comparison expressions.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi CLASS_LITERAL_EXPRESSION / ts BINARY_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: escaped identifier label versus annotation on lambda call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a labeled WHILE; native calls an identifier with an annotated lambda suffix.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi LABEL / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: comma in object argument supertype list versus outer value arguments
cases.psiVsNative: PSI object declaration owns both supertypes; native assigns the second supertype to the outer argument list.
cases.key: C @ … > VALUE_ARGUMENT > OBJECT_LITERAL > OBJECT_DECLARATION: psi USER_TYPE / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: qualified cast target versus navigation after cast
cases.psiVsNative: PSI casts to qualified type A.B; native navigates from the cast to A.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_WITH_TYPE / ts DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: generic qualified receiver versus binary operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a + qualified generic b<T>.c; native attaches the generic qualifier and member to a+b.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: generic call suffix versus membership operator precedence
cases.psiVsNative: PSI membership has a generic call RHS; native applies the call suffix to the membership expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi BINARY_EXPRESSION / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: dynamic type keyword versus user type in supertype position
cases.psiVsNative: PSI keeps a DYNAMIC_TYPE node and dynamic token; native uses user_type/type_identifier.
cases.key: C @ … > PROPERTY > OBJECT_LITERAL > OBJECT_DECLARATION: psi CLASS_BODY / ts USER_TYPE

cases.grammarArea: newline modifier ownership for class declarations
cases.psiVsNative: PSI CLASS starts at annotation; native emits a sibling identifier and starts CLASS at class.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: CLASS @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: newline modifier ownership for property declarations
cases.psiVsNative: PSI PROPERTY owns private; native leaves private as a sibling identifier.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: PROPERTY @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: annotated generic declaration modifiers versus generic lambda call ambiguity
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has an annotated interface with a companion object; native parses an annotation and generic infix/lambda call.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: CLASS @ ts annotation / psi ANNOTATION_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: semicolon before else branch ownership
cases.psiVsNative: PSI IF owns reference y in ELSE; native leaves else as a sibling identifier/expression.
cases.key: A function_body > ERROR simple_identifier | psi REFERENCE_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: for control-body ownership across newline before compound return
cases.psiVsNative: PSI FOR owns a return with parenthesized expression; native leaves the return as a sibling.
cases.key: C @ … > BLOCK > FOR > BODY: psi PARENTHESIZED / ts (none)

cases.grammarArea: contextual setter keyword versus ordinary call with lambda argument
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has CALL_EXPRESSION with value and lambda arguments; native creates a setter.
cases.key: C declaration start only in ts: PROPERTY_ACCESSOR @ ts function_declaration / psi REFERENCE_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: newline separates object expression and following lambda statement
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has sibling object and lambda expressions; native calls the object expression with a lambda suffix.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > FUN > BLOCK: psi OBJECT_LITERAL / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: fun keyword selector versus ordinary identifier call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI builds a FUN selector; native builds a simple_identifier-based CALL_EXPRESSION.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: FUN @ ts navigation_suffix / psi FUN

cases.grammarArea: annotated extension property modifiers across newline
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has an annotated extension property with getter; native emits an annotation and infix expression before the getter.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: PROPERTY @ ts annotation / psi ANNOTATION_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: repeated newline-separated modifiers versus infix statement parsing
cases.psiVsNative: PSI keeps every private token in a declaration modifier list; native parses some of that list as infix statements.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: PROPERTY @ ts statements / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: interface declaration in expression position versus infix/comparison parsing
cases.psiVsNative: PSI retains a CLASS declaration for interface I; native treats interface and its body as expression pieces.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: CLASS @ ts infix_expression / psi CLASS

cases.grammarArea: annotated named object declaration in expression body
cases.psiVsNative: PSI retains the annotated named OBJECT_DECLARATION; native builds an object literal and infix/lambda expression.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: OBJECT_DECLARATION @ ts annotation / psi ANNOTATION_ENTRY

cases.grammarArea: companion property modifier versus infix expression parsing
cases.psiVsNative: PSI has a PROPERTY owning companion; native parses an infix expression.
cases.key: C declaration start only in psi: PROPERTY @ ts simple_identifier / psi MODIFIER_LIST

cases.grammarArea: var keyword selector versus identifier call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI retains a destructuring declaration for the var selector; native parses a simple_identifier-based call.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION: psi DESTRUCTURING_DECLARATION / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: return keyword selector versus identifier call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI treats return as a jump selector with lambda operand; native treats it as an identifier call.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION: psi FUNCTION_LITERAL / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: throw keyword selector versus identifier operand
cases.psiVsNative: PSI treats throw as a jump selector; native treats it as a normal identifier in a binary expression.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY: psi DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION / ts BINARY_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: if keyword selector versus identifier call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI keeps an IF selector; native treats if as a normal identifier call.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION: psi IF / ts CALL_EXPRESSION

cases.grammarArea: super keyword selector in indexed assignment target
cases.psiVsNative: PSI retains a SUPER_EXPRESSION selector in the array receiver; native uses a transparent simple identifier.
cases.key: C @ … > BLOCK > BINARY_EXPRESSION > ARRAY_ACCESS_EXPRESSION: psi DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION / ts INDICES

cases.grammarArea: while keyword selector versus identifier call
cases.psiVsNative: PSI retains a WHILE selector; native uses an identifier-based call with a trailing lambda.
cases.key: C @ KtFile > PROPERTY > DOT_QUALIFIED_EXPRESSION: psi WHILE / ts CALL_EXPRESSION
